title: AI Resume Builder for Indian Engineering Students: Crack Product & Service Placements
description: How Indian B.Tech / MCA students can generate ATS-friendly resumes for on-campus and off-campus placements using AI tools.

image.alt: AI Resume Builder for Indian Engineering Campus Placements

body:
Engineering students across India face intense competition during placement seasons. InternFlow's AI Resume Builder is specifically designed to help Indian students convert coursework, coding competitions, and GitHub projects into high-scoring resumes that pass both campus screening and external ATS filters.

## 1. Key Sections for Indian Placement Resumes

- Technical Skills: Programming Languages (C++, Java, Python, JavaScript), Core CS (DSA, OS, DBMS, Computer Networks), Web Technologies, and Database Systems.
- Competitive Programming & Contests: Include your LeetCode, CodeChef, or Codeforces handle if you have solved significant problem sets.
- Major & Minor Projects: Detail 2-3 full-stack or systems projects with live deployment links and GitHub repositories.
- Internships / Experience: Document responsibilities, technical stacks used, and outcomes achieved.

## 2. Instant PDF Generation with InternFlow

Build your placement-ready resume for free using InternFlow's AI resume builder, ensuring clean formatting, zero watermarks, and high ATS scores.
